product_metadata.title: Rubbermaid® Mixermate™ Leak-Resistant Pitcher, 1 Gallon
features: Rubbermaid pitcher is designed for easy mixing, serving, and storing
Leak-resistant lids are designed to prevent spills while you're shaking the pitcher or pouring from it
Ideal for making drinks from mixes, or as a sangria pitcher or lemonade pitcher
Comfortable, rounded side handle is designed for easy pouring; large lid opening makes filling easy
Plastic pitcher is BPA-free and dishwasher-safe
description: Rubbermaid Mixermate pitchers are designed for easy mixing, serving, and storing. The leak-resistant lids help to prevent spills while you're shaking the pitcher or pouring from it. The rounded handle makes pouring more comfortable. Rubbermaid Mixermate pitchers are BPA-free, dishwasher-safe, and made in the USA.
